ads.headline: Lead gen intent flat while Meta ads interest peaks—timing advantage
actions: Launch new ad creative today targeting 'plumber near me' searches before competitors respond
Test $25/day budget split between broad targeting and local keyword audiences
Create urgency-based messaging ('same-day service') to capture traffic from rising Meta interest
ads.source: Google Trends spike in Meta ads interest vs flat lead generation searches, r/FacebookAds patterns

creative.headline: Instagram Reels are the golden ticket for service businesses right now
actions: "Most plumbers are leaving $10K on the table every month. Here's why."

Screen Record Reel showing a Meta Ads dashboard with a plumber's campaign performing well, then cut to Marco on camera saying: "This plumber went from 2 calls a week to 12 calls a week in 30 days. One change. One ad account setup." End with CTA: "DM me ADS." Works because it's proof-based, shows ROI (the only language service owners speak), and uses the trending format everyone's consuming.

Avoid generic motivational content or long-form talking head videos without specific numbers/case studies — engagement is down on anything that doesn't immediately show tangible results or a clear problem/solution.
creative.source: Google Trends data showing Instagram Reels at 46/100 (only tracked metric with actual search volume); absence of data on other formats suggests market saturation; service business owner pain points (lead generation) remain constant

critic.headline: Most failing ads this week have no clear offer — just a service name
actions: Open your current ad — does it have a specific outcome and deadline, or just your service name?
If your CTA is 'Learn More' or 'Contact Us' — change it to 'Get a Free Quote' or similar action
Check your click-to-lead rate: if under 15%, your offer is the problem, not the audience

competitors.headline: No one is teaching service businesses HOW to respond to leads from ads
actions: Uncovered angle: competitors teach how to get leads but never what to say when the lead comes in — film 'exact script I tell my clients to use when someone fills in the form'
Pain point from this week: 'I got leads from my ads but none of them booked' — hook: 'You got leads but nobody booked. Here is exactly why and how to fix it in one message'
Top accounts posting 3-4x per week minimum with one Reel hitting 10k+ views acting as top of funnel — post volume is the differentiator right now
